quotations.old_english: Heó nearolíce (angsumlíce, v.l.) geþreád wæs mid feferádle
Þá eóde hé hider and þider nearolíce geswænced in his geþóhte

quotations.latin: strictim (moecham mamis strictim tollentis obuncat, Aid. 164. 3)

quotations.old_english: Ne anhyre ðú þ-bar; nearolíce (nequiter) þú dó. Þe nearolíce (nequiter) dóþ beóð ge-teórode

source_text: nearulíce. II. add :-- Heó nearolíce (angsumlíce, v.l.) geþreád wæs mid feferádle anxietate febrium urgetur. Gr. D. 29, 21. Þá eóde hé hider and þider nearolíce geswænced in his geþóhte cum huc illucque anxius pergeret, 251, 24. IV. closely, tightly :-- Nearolíce strictim (moecham mamis strictim tollentis obuncat, Aid. 164. 3), An. Ox. 18 b, 90. V. illiberally (?), evilly, v. nearu-þanc :-- Ne anhyre ðú þ-bar; nearolíce (nequiter) þú dó. Þe nearolíce (nequiter) dóþ beóð ge-teórode, Ps. Rdr. 36, 8-9.
